color.eyedropper: Pick a color from the screen
color.hexError: Enter a hex color, like FF8800

export.title: Export
export.description: Choose the file type, background and area to export.
export.svgNote: Effects SVG can't represent are embedded as images, and background blur is left out.

pdf.sharpHint: Shapes and text stay crisp at any zoom and in print. Effects that can't be kept sharp are saved as images.
pdf.flattenedHint: The whole page is saved as one picture. It looks exactly like the canvas, but blurs when you zoom in.
pdf.selectableHint: Looks the same everywhere, and you can search and copy the text.
pdf.outlinesHint: Text becomes shapes. Looks the same everywhere, but can't be searched or copied.

quality.nowOnScreen: Right now it takes about {px} px on screen.
quality.exportsVector: Exports and Catalog mode's preview and PDF draw it as sharp as they need.
quality.exportsRaster: Exports and Catalog mode's preview and PDF draw from the original at full quality ({size} px).
quality.vectorTip: A vector picture is drawn on the canvas only as sharp as it shows, to keep the canvas fast. {now} Zoom in and it's drawn sharper. {exports}
quality.fullTip: The canvas shows this picture at its own size, {size} px. Exports and Catalog mode use it at full quality too.
quality.previewTip: To keep the canvas fast, it shows a smaller copy of this picture, as sharp as the picture looks on screen. {now} Zoom in and a sharper copy loads. {exports}
